liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Spanish Jam** (1 review): The reviewer claims words cannot do the Spanish Jam performance justice [10]

## The recordings

- **gd1970-02-11.126251.sbd.wolfe-lee-smith.flac16** (recommended): matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 14 songs; 121 min; rated 4.67/5 by 3 [1]
- **gd1970-02-11.sbd.smith.patched.99154.sbeok.flac16**: soundboard; 14 songs; 120 min; rated 3.6/5 by 10 [2]
- **gd70-02-11.early-late.sbd.sacks.90.sbefail.shnf**: soundboard; 13 songs; 117 min; rated 4.81/5 by 77 [3]. Said about its sound: The reviewer expresses regret that the Dark Star cut is a huge pity; Despite many musicians, the performance sounds tight and flows well without overstaging; The reviewer describes the Cumberland Blues version as scorching [10][11][14][16][18][19][20]
- **gd1970-02-11.sbd.warner.patched.28292.sbeok.flac16**: soundboard; 13 songs; 121 min; rated 4.69/5 by 13 [4]

## Around the show

- Peter Green and most Allman Brothers joined the Dead on stage for this section [10]
- The reviewer describes the collaboration as pure rage and a special time [12]
- Phil Lesh is highlighted as leading the way during the Spanish Jam [15]
- The reviewer compares it favorably to their previous poor recording of the jam [12]
- The reviewer calls it a dress rehearsal for the later Allman tour dates [14]
- The reviewer notes the show is overshadowed by the February 13-14 performances [16]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1970-02-11.126251.sbd.wolfe-lee-smith.flac16**: taped by Pat Lee and Don Wolfe; transferred by Matt Smith; source: SBD MR > DAT (disc 1 and first part of Star, last part lovelight via a DAT transfer so is not from circ. source); MAR > ? > R @ 3 @ ips. (aud patch source used… [1]. Also: Matt remastered the tape using a direct tape head output chain; The transfer method followed advice from Dan Healy for a clean signal [1]
- **gd1970-02-11.sbd.smith.patched.99154.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Matt Smith; source: SBD > Reel [2]. Also: Sources include SBD MR, DAT, and audience tape patched by Matt Smith; Don Wolfe provided the audience reel and Pat Lee the second board reel [2]
- **gd70-02-11.early-late.sbd.sacks.90.sbefail.shnf**: transferred by Darrin Sacks; source: Soundboard [3]. Also: Dark Star has an abrupt splice or cut at approximately 6:57; Lovelight contains a splice at the 30:16 mark [3]
- **gd1970-02-11.sbd.warner.patched.28292.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by EAC and FLAC encoding by Jack Warner; source: Master soundboard reels > DAT > CD > Plextor PX-708A extraction (EAC v0.95 prebeta 5) > tracking (CD Wave) > sector boundary verification (shntool v2.0.3) >… [4]. Also: Dark Star is patched using a master audience tape source; This source lacks a patch for the Lovelight section [4]
